summary: Six Tampa Multifamily refinance opportunities qualified with confirmed active loans and executed-note maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31, ranked by maturity date. Duplicates were consolidated (Dogwood Park 1). Records were excluded for reasons including executed extensions beyond the window (R8811), released/unknown-status loans, unconfirmed or inferred maturities, in-scope contact/owner verification failures, out-of-market/asset-type, and post-cutoff publication.
limitations: As-of cutoff 2026-08-31: evidence published/effective after this date (e.g., recorded release for R9410 on 2026-09-10) was not applied and could change eligibility later.
Outstanding balances were not provided in sources; reported as null.
Emails are only included when published; some entries have null contact_email.
Duplicate detection relied on shared entity_id; other potential duplication signals were not provided.
Unsigned drafts (e.g., U-R8389-3) were not treated as controlling; future execution could alter maturities.
